backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profiles, production records, dispatch records, work-in-hand tracking, and daily production reports with role-based access control (admin/viewer) using AccessControl mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: useGetCallerRole hook, AuthGuard role-based rendering, Layout navigation filtering, and form/button disabling for viewer users.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components, pages, and hooks describing role-based access control implementation across the application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and root div mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with all routes (dashboard, production entry/history, dispatch, work-in-hand, daily reports), wrapping pages with AuthGuard and Layout, plus ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Access denied screen component displaying a shield icon and login button for unauthenticated users attempting to access protected routes.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that checks login status and user role, redirects viewers from admin-only routes to production dashboard, shows profile setup modal for new users, and displays loading/access denied states.
frontend/src/components/DailyProductionR: Filter component for daily production reports with date range and operation name filters. Includes predefined list of 17 default operations and applies filters to report list.

Form component for creating and editing daily production reports with fields for date, operation, production numbers, and auto-calculated in-hand inventory. Uses custom hooks for CRUD operations and role-based access control.
Sortable table component displaying daily production reports with edit and delete actions. Supports multi-column sorting and role-based action visibility.
Reusable date range filter component with start/end date inputs and apply/clear actions. Validates date ranges to ensure start date is before end date.
frontend/src/components/DispatchEntryFor: Form component for recording dispatch entries with fields for date, container type, quantity, destination, and tracking reference. Includes role-based access control to disable form for viewers.
frontend/src/components/DispatchRecordsT: Sortable table component displaying dispatch records with columns for date, container type, quantity, destination, and tracking reference. Supports multi-column sorting functionality.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with responsive navigation, header with branding, and role-based menu filtering (viewers see only dashboard links). Includes mobile menu toggle and integrates authentication via LoginButton.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states. Clears query cache on logout and handles authentication errors.
frontend/src/components/OperationCompari: Bar chart component displaying total completed production grouped and sorted by operation name using Recharts. Shows empty state when no data is available.
frontend/src/components/ProductionDashbo: Table component displaying daily production metrics per operation including today's production, total completed, dispatched, and in-hand quantities. Shows empty state for no data.
frontend/src/components/ProductionHistor: Sortable table component for production records with columns for date, container type, quantity, shift, and notes. Supports ascending/descending sorting on all columns with visual indicators.
frontend/src/components/ProductionTrendC: Line chart component showing daily total production trends over time using Recharts. Aggregates production by date and displays chronologically sorted data.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup requiring name input. Non-dismissible dialog that saves user profile via mutation hook with loading state.
frontend/src/components/RecentProduction: Table component displaying the most recent production records with configurable limit (default 10). Shows date, container type, quantity, shift, and optional notes.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying key metrics with title, numeric value, icon, and optional description. Features hover shadow effect and icon badge styling.
React component that displays a table of work-in-hand inventory records showing container types, produced quantities, dispatched quantities, and current inventory levels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication, creating actors with Internet Identity credentials and initializing access control with admin tokens from URL parameters.
React Query mutation hook for adding dispatch records to the backend and invalidating related queries (dispatchRecords and workInHandStatus).
frontend/src/hooks/useAddProductionRecor: React Query mutation hook for adding production records to the backend and invalidating related queries (productionRecords and workInHandStatus).
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateDailyProduct: React Query mutation hook for creating daily production reports and invalidating the dailyProductionReports query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteDailyProduct: React Query mutation hook that finds a report by date and operation name, then deletes it by ID and invalidates the dailyProductionReports cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDailyProduct: React Query hook that fetches all daily production reports from the backend with auto-refresh every 30 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllDispatchReco: React Query hook that fetches all dispatch records from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllProductionRe: React Query hook that fetches all production records from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerRole.ts: React Query hook that fetches the current caller's role from the backend with enhanced loading state tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the current caller's user profile from the backend with enhanced loading state tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetProductionRecor: React Query hook that fetches production records filtered by date range, falling back to all records if dates are not provided.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetWorkInHandStatu: React Query hook that fetches work-in-hand status records showing current inventory levels.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validity with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks if the current caller has admin privileges.
frontend/src/hooks/useMonthlyProductionM: Custom hook that calculates monthly production metrics including total produced, remaining to target (100), completion percentage, and daily average from daily production reports.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Consolidated file containing multiple React Query hooks for user profiles, production records, dispatch records, and work-in-hand status (appears to duplicate functionality from individual hook files).
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook for saving the caller's user profile name and invalidating the currentUserProfile cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateDailyProduct: React Query mutation hook that finds a report by date and operation name, then updates it by ID and invalidates the dailyProductionReports cache.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom industrial-themed color palette for light and dark modes, including CSS variables for UI components and utility classes for tables and cards.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/DailyProductionReport: Page for managing daily production reports with filtering, editing capabilities, and role-based access control that restricts viewers from editing.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard displaying production metrics summary cards (total produced, dispatched, work in hand, container types) and a table of recent production records.
Page for recording and viewing container dispatch records with role-based access control preventing viewers from adding new entries.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionDashboardPa: Live production dashboard showing real-time metrics, monthly production summary with target tracking, production trends chart, and operation comparison visualizations with auto-refresh.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionEntryPage.t: Form page for entering new production records with fields for date, container type, quantity, shift, and notes, restricted to non-viewer roles.
frontend/src/pages/ProductionHistoryPage: Page displaying historical production records with filtering and editing capabilities, showing all reports or filtered subset based on user selection.
frontend/src/pages/WorkInHandPage.tsx: React page component that displays work-in-hand status with summary cards (total inventory, container types, production, dispatches) and a table of records by operation, with loading states and viewer role notification.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, container settings, border radius variables, industrial shadows, Inter font family, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a mobile-first industrial production tracking application for 40ft High Cube Container manufacturing with 17 operations, role-based access control, and features including authentication, production entry, dashboard, history, dispatch tracking, and work-in-hand status.
